messages.text: What is EVM, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

EVM is Error Vector Magnitude, a measurement of the difference between a reference waveform and a measured waveform [16]. Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it include using the R&S CMX500 for SRS RF measurements such as TX power and EVM across regular SRS, SRS antenna switching, SRS carrier switching, and configurations such as 1T2R, 1T4R, and 2T4R, including selecting which SRS resource to measure [14]. They also include 5G NR pre-conformance EVM verification choices such as checking DUT EVM against specified limits, measuring at DUT maximum and minimum power, and using TPC closed-loop settings to set minimum power after maximum-power EVM verification [4]. For R&S CMPHEAD30-related mmWave RF generator evaluation, EVM understanding matters because the listed EVM conditions are SCS 60 kHz / 120 kHz, 64QAM, +15 °C to +35 °C, and within ±5 °C from last I/Q alignment, with EVM marked as measured values [8].

Time Domain Channel Properties
[[Time Domain Channel Properties]]（TDCP）是 [[Release 18]] 中用於描述 channel time-domain behavior、[[UE]] relative mobility 與 associated Doppler 的新 measurement / CSI-related quantity，可協助 [[gNB]] 在 high-speed scenarios 中調整 transmission configuration。[[R18 CSI enhancements for high-speed Scenario]] [[TDCP Reporting]]

CMX500 SRS RF measurements
[[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] RF measurement use case：針對 5G NR [[SRS]] modes / configurations 執行 TX power、[[EVM]] 等量測，並支援 [[SRS antenna switching]] / carrier switching 場景；[[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]] 進一步補充 SRS antenna switching 的 xTyR 技術背景與 receiver-side [[Receiver Pre-adder]] / selection 概念。

R&S CMX500 › Warranty and service
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]：

- Base unit warranty：1 year。
- All other items warranty：1 year。
- Calibration service plans：up to five years；on demand 為 pay per calibration。
- Warranty and repair service plans：up to five years；on demand 為 standard price repair。
- Extended periods：contact [[Rohde & Schwarz]] sales office。

EVM › 來源定義
依 [[WIC Glossary]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- EVM 展開為 Error Vector Magnitude。

依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- Error Vector Magnitude（EVM）是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。
- 來源將 EVM 放在 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] test case **6.4.2.1 Error Vector Magnitude PUCCH/PUSCH**。
- Test ID 會設定 RB Allocation 與 modulation scheme。
- PUCCH subtests 需參考 application note chapter 2.1 notes。
- Apply configuration 後，需確認 measured DUT EVM 位於 specified range 內。
- Test case 要求在 DUT max power 與 min power 下量測 EVM。
- CMX 會先自動設定 max power；完成 max power EVM verification 後，DUT 需使用 TPC Closed Loop settings 設定為 min power。

[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 對同一 test case 的定義與限值摘要相同，並支撐既有 EVM 頁面內容。

R&S CMX-KA401 › 與 POLQA / OTT 的關係
- OTT voice quality no POLQA：[[R&S CMX-KS600B]] + [[R&S CMX-KA100]] + [[R&S CMX-KA180]] + [[R&S CMX-KA401]]。
- OTT voice + POLQA via OTT：再加 [[R&S CMX-KA181]]。
- Basic POLQA：使用 [[R&S CMX-KA181]]；來源明示 KA401 not required for basic POLQA。

德宏 › 可追溯範圍
- 本頁只記錄圖上列名，不推論供應合約、出貨量、市占率、客戶、材料規格、國別或 R&S 往來關係。

- [[HSD PCB image 15]] 的「石英布」與 [[HSD PCB image 18]] / [[HSD PCB image 8]] 的 [[Q-Glass]] / 石英纖維看似相關，但來源沒有給出材料標準或正式等同關係，本頁不自行合併定義。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

Constellation Insight Tool
[[Constellation Insight Tool]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz highlights its unique CMX500 one-box tester tailored for NTN testing at MWC Barcelona 2026]] 中描述的 [[R&S CMX500]] NTN testing 軟體工具，用於 satellite constellation visualization、mobility management、trajectory observation 與 handover scenario support。

Time Domain Channel Properties › Spec change 線索
[[TDCP Reporting]] 列出：

- [[3GPP TS 38.215]]：TDCP definition。
- [[3GPP TS 38.214]]：TDCP reporting changes；來源說 this spec best describes how this feature works。
- [[3GPP TS 38.211]]：No changes relevant to Rel-18 TDCP CSI reporting。
- [[3GPP TS 38.212]]：TDCP reporting parameter changes。
- [[3GPP TS 38.306]]：UE Capabilities changes。
- [[3GPP 38.822]]：TDCP-related capabilities。

來源沒有列出 spec version、CR number 或 clause，因此這些只作為待回查索引。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › SRS modes and configurations
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]：

- CMX supports all SRS modes：regular SRS、SRS antenna switching、SRS carrier switching。
- CMX supports all SRS configurations，例如 1T2R、1T4R、2T4R（2 SRS sent at a time on 4 antennas overall）。
- Specific SRS measurements 包含 TX Power、EVM and more。
- Scheduling is automatically adapted。
- Measurement is aware of the SRS positions。
- 使用者可 select the SRS resource to measure。

依 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]]，[[3GPP TS 38.214]] 中的 xTyR 表示：同一時間 UE 以 Y 個 antennas 中的 X 個 antennas 同時傳送某個 SRS resource 的 X 個 SRS APs；另一時間再以其他 X 個 antennas 傳送另一個 SRS resource 的 X 個 SRS APs。來源列出的 configurations 包含 1T2R、2T4R、1T4R、1T4R/2T4R、1T=1R、2T=2R、4T=4R。

EMITE
[[EMITE]] 是位於西班牙的 OTA Test Systems 公司；[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 稱其與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 合作，將 [[R&S CMX500]] 最新測試能力整合到 EMITE over-the-air chambers，以支援 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] OTA measurements。

EVM
[[EVM]] 是 Error Vector Magnitude；[[WIC Glossary]] 只提供縮寫展開，[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 則在 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance test case 6.4.2.1 中說明 EVM 是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。

R&S CMX-KA401
[[R&S CMX-KA401]] 是 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 advanced audio measurement / generator and playback software option；[[CMX_Configuration_Guide_Audio-Testing]] 中將它列為 OTT voice quality、customer WAV injection、VoIP wave injection、E2E audio delay、IP streaming、playback/record 與 non-realtime IMS 等 scope 的 conditional option。

- [[AI Server PCB test image 25]] 未說明德宏在玻纖布分類中的產品規格、供應客戶、出貨期間或列名完整性。

- [[HSD PCB image 18]] 與 [[HSD PCB image 8]] 未說明「德宏 領先佈局」的定義、證據或期間。

Network Infrastructure T&M drivers › 使用限制
- 本頁是簡報摘要，不是正式產品 roadmap、datasheet、quote configuration 或 standards compliance statement。
- 來源多處為圖像 / 產品組合 slide，markitdown 轉檔可能遺失圖片中細節。

依 [[R18 CSI enhancements for high-speed Scenario]]：

- TDCP 全名為 Time Domain Channel Properties。
- 它是 a new CSI quantity。
- 它 can provide additional information about time domain channel variability and User Equipment motion relative to the gNodeB。
- 來源說 TDCP measured via [[CSI-RS]] is being investigated to help the network track the channel's behavior over time。
- 來源在 development section 說 report quantity `tdcp` should be added，主要在 [[RRC]] 與 [[MAC]]。
- [[PHY]] can treat the new report type TDCP as a new [[CSI report]] type。

依 [[TDCP Reporting]]：

- TDCP is a new measurement introduced in Rel-18。
- TDCP provides CSI information on the relative mobility of the UE and the associated Doppler on the channel with the gNodeB。
- TDCP can be used to adjust configuration parameters such as codebook type or reference signal，以 adapt to channel conditions and ensure robust transmission in high-speed scenarios。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › 2T4R example
依 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]]，2T4R 範例包含一個 periodic SRS resource set，內含兩個 SRS resources，每個 resource 有兩個 SRS ports，第二個 resource 的 port pair 對應不同 UE antenna port pair：

| Resource | nrofSRS-Ports | L0 | PeriodicityInslots | Offset | Antenna ports |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| ResourceId=0 | 2 | 8 | 10 | 0 | AP0, AP1 |
| ResourceId=1 | 2 | 10 | 10 | 0 | AP2, AP3 |

EVM › 1C111 中的 5G NR EVM limits
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]，EVM measurement results 必須低於 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] Table 6.4.2.1.5-1 的 maximum error percentage，並套用 Table 6.4.2.1.5-2 定義的 Test Tolerance（TT）。來源摘錄的 Average EVM Level limits 為：

| Modulation | Average EVM level limit |
|---|---|
| Pi/2-BPSK | 30 + TT % |
| QPSK | 17.5 + TT % |
| 16 QAM | 12.5 + TT % |
| 64 QAM | 8 + TT % |
| 256 QAM | 3.5 + TT % |

TT 來源摘錄為：

| 條件 | TT |
|---|---|
| All except 256QAM | 0% |
| 256 QAM @ max power | 0.3% |
| 256 QAM @ min power | 1.1% |

來源範例：DUT on n78、100 MHz BW、PUCCH Test ID 1（QPSK）時，specified maximum EVM 為 **17.5 + 0 %**，且 CMX EVM measurement 位於 3GPP limits 內。

answer.text: EVM is Error Vector Magnitude, a measurement of the difference between a reference waveform and a measured waveform [16]. Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it include using the R&S CMX500 for SRS RF measurements such as TX power and EVM across regular SRS, SRS antenna switching, SRS carrier switching, and configurations such as 1T2R, 1T4R, and 2T4R, including selecting which SRS resource to measure [14]. They also include 5G NR pre-conformance EVM verification choices such as checking DUT EVM against specified limits, measuring at DUT maximum and minimum power, and using TPC closed-loop settings to set minimum power after maximum-power EVM verification [4]. For R&S CMPHEAD30-related mmWave RF generator evaluation, EVM understanding matters because the listed EVM conditions are SCS 60 kHz / 120 kHz, 64QAM, +15 °C to +35 °C, and within ±5 °C from last I/Q alignment, with EVM marked as measured values [8].

cited_passages.text:
EVM › 來源定義
依 [[WIC Glossary]]（來源正式日期未標示；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- EVM 展開為 Error Vector Magnitude。

依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- Error Vector Magnitude（EVM）是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。
- 來源將 EVM 放在 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] test case **6.4.2.1 Error Vector Magnitude PUCCH/PUSCH**。
- Test ID 會設定 RB Allocation 與 modulation scheme。
- PUCCH subtests 需參考 application note chapter 2.1 notes。
- Apply configuration 後，需確認 measured DUT EVM 位於 specified range 內。
- Test case 要求在 DUT max power 與 min power 下量測 EVM。
- CMX 會先自動設定 max power；完成 max power EVM verification 後，DUT 需使用 TPC Closed Loop settings 設定為 min power。

[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 對同一 test case 的定義與限值摘要相同，並支撐既有 EVM 頁面內容。

R&S CMPHEAD30 › mmWave RF generator
| 項目 | 規格 |
|---|---|
| 搭配 | [[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CM-Z30A]] |
| Duplex mode | half duplex（TDD） |
| Frequency range | 28 GHz band：24.25 GHz to 31.80 GHz；39 GHz band：37.00 GHz to 43.50 GHz |
| Frequency resolution | < 0.1 Hz |
| Maximum reverse power | 0 V DC，+25 dBm |
| Output level range | 28 GHz band PEP –84 dBm to +20 dBm；37 GHz ≤ f ≤ 40 GHz PEP –78 dBm to +19 dBm；40 GHz < f ≤ 43.5 GHz PEP –78 dBm to +17 dBm |
| Output level uncertainty | 28 GHz band，–50 dBm to +15 dBm CW：< 2.5 dB；39 GHz band，–45 dBm to +10 dBm CW：< 3.0 dB |
| Output level repeatability | 1 h warm-up 後 typ. < 0.2 dB |
| Isolation of RF ports | RF 1 to RF 2 > 27 dB，35 dB typ. |

EVM 條件：SCS 60 kHz / 120 kHz、64QAM、+15 °C to +35 °C、within ±5 °C from last I/Q alignment。來源標示 EVM 為 measured values。

CMX500 SRS RF measurements › SRS modes and configurations
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]：

- CMX supports all SRS modes：regular SRS、SRS antenna switching、SRS carrier switching。
- CMX supports all SRS configurations，例如 1T2R、1T4R、2T4R（2 SRS sent at a time on 4 antennas overall）。
- Specific SRS measurements 包含 TX Power、EVM and more。
- Scheduling is automatically adapted。
- Measurement is aware of the SRS positions。
- 使用者可 select the SRS resource to measure。

依 [[Antenna Switching and Receiver Pre-adder_Selection for Multi-port SRS]]，[[3GPP TS 38.214]] 中的 xTyR 表示：同一時間 UE 以 Y 個 antennas 中的 X 個 antennas 同時傳送某個 SRS resource 的 X 個 SRS APs；另一時間再以其他 X 個 antennas 傳送另一個 SRS resource 的 X 個 SRS APs。來源列出的 configurations 包含 1T2R、2T4R、1T4R、1T4R/2T4R、1T=1R、2T=2R、4T=4R。

EVM
[[EVM]] 是 Error Vector Magnitude；[[WIC Glossary]] 只提供縮寫展開，[[1C111_0e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 與 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 則在 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance test case 6.4.2.1 中說明 EVM 是 reference waveform 與 measured waveform 之間差異的量測。
